title: Key West 1-Hour Guide-Supervised Freestyle Jet Ski Ride
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is the closest Six Fins alternative to renting a jet ski and riding independently. Your guide leads you safely to appropriate freeriding areas and then supervises while you enjoy the water at your own pace. It is similar to hiring a ski instructor who knows how to reach the right runs safely instead of wandering unfamiliar terrain. The experience emphasizes riding time, flexibility, and safety rather than a fixed island-tour itinerary.
